title: Density Bounds for the 3x+1 Problem II. Krasikov Inequalities

consultation.scope: Author manuscript dated 15 December 1993: introduction, Theorem 1.1, Section 2 definitions (2.1)-(2.6), LP formulation and Theorem 2.2, Section 3 numerical discussion.
consultation.remaining: LP computations not rerun. The manuscript's introduction allows integer targets but (2.2) scales by 2^y a; it is not a substitute for checking signed height inequalities.

notes: Obtains a predecessor-count exponent above 0.81 using feasible linear-program weights for residue-class difference inequalities. Direct precursor of Krasikov-Lagarias 2003 and the laboratory's strict-grid argument. Existing signed-height analysis in docs/problems/juggler_negative_preimage_density.md remains necessary: (2a+1)/3 is larger than 2a/3. Bibliographic recovery does not remove that correction or imply harmonic divergence.
